title: A protocol for isolating and imaging large extracellular vesicles or midbody remnants from mammalian cell culture
protocol: Remove medium from HeLa cells when they are approximately 70% confluent.
Add 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA and incubate at 37°C for 5–10 min until cells detach.
Pipette the cells up and down to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Mix resuspended cells with an equal volume of DMEM/F12 medium.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant, and resuspend in DMEM/F12 medium.
Split cells 1:5 (6–8 x 10^5 cells) into a T75 flask in DMEM/F12 medium.
Culture HeLa-CCL-2 and HeLa-MKLP1-GFP cells on poly-L-lysine coated coverslips in a 12-well plate using DMEM/F12 medium (3–4 x 10^4 cells per well).
Incubate the cells until they reach 60%–70% confluency.
Characterize the cells using immunofluorescence or an assay of choice when cells are at 60%–70% confluency.
Plate HeLa cells (6–8 x 10^5 cells per flask) in T175 flasks with 20 ml DMEM/F12 medium.
Once cells reach approximately 75% confluence, vigorously shake the flask from side to side 10 times to detach midbodies.
Harvest the medium into a 50 ml conical tube once midbodies are detached.
Centrifuge the medium at 1000 x g for 10 min to remove dead cell debris.
Remove the supernatant carefully and transfer it to a new 50 mL conical tube.
If the medium turns yellow, replace it with fresh medium and incubate for at least 24 hours before harvesting.
Pipette the medium vigorously over the surface of the dish multiple times if cells are in 150 mm dishes instead of T175 flasks to dislodge MBRs.
Culture cells in T175 flasks for at least 2 days and no longer than 5 days before collecting medium.
Add 30% PEG6000 solution to the cleared conditioned medium to achieve a final concentration of 1.5% (v/v) PEG6000.
Incubate the mixture containing PEG6000 for 12–18 hours at 2–8°C.
Centrifuge the incubated mixture at 1000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet the PEG/MBR.
Resuspend the PEG/MBR pellet in 1 mL sterile PBS.
Incubate cleared conditioned medium with PEG5000 coated 30 nm gold particles solution to yield a final concentration of 0.02% (v/v).
Incubate the mixture for 12–18 hours at 2–8°C.
Centrifuge at 1000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet the gold/MBR.
Resuspend the gold/MBR pellet in 1 mL sterile PBS.
Centrifuge the PEG/MBR PBS solution or gold/MBR PBS solution at 1000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet the MBRs.
Immersion-fix the MBR pellet in immersion fix sodium phosphate solution for 2 hours at 20–25°C.
Rinse the MBR pellet five times for 5 minutes each in PB.
Post-fix the MBR pellet in post fix sodium phosphate solution for 1 hour at 20–25°C.
Rinse the MBR pellet five times for 5 minutes each in PB.
Dehydrate the MBR pellet in a graded ethanol series (35%, 50%, 70%, 80%, and 90%) diluted in dH2O for 5 minutes each at 20–25°C.
Dehydrate the MBR pellet in 95% ethanol diluted in dH2O for 10 minutes at 20–25°C.
Dehydrate the MBR pellet in 100% ethanol twice for 10 minutes each at 20–25°C.
Dehydrate the MBR pellet in dry acetone (AC) twice for 7 minutes each at 20–25°C.
Incubate the dehydrated MBR pellet with 10% EMbed 812 in AC for 60 minutes at 20–25°C.
Incubate the dehydrated MBR pellet with 25% EMbed 812 in AC for 60 minutes at 20–25°C.
Incubate the dehydrated MBR pellet with 50% EMbed 812 in AC for 12–18 hours at 20–25°C.
Incubate the dehydrated MBR pellet with 75% EMbed 812 in AC for 60 minutes at 20–25°C.
Incubate the dehydrated MBR pellet with 100% EMbed 812 for 45 minutes at 60°C.
Incubate the MBR pellet in fresh EMBed 812 for 48 hours at 60°C for embedding and polymerization.
Section the MBR pellet on an ultramicrotome into 100-nm sections.
Collect the sections on 2 × 1 mm slot copper grids.
Post-stain with 8% uranyl acetate in 50% ethanol for 15 minutes at 60°C.
Post-stain with Reynolds lead citrate for 10 minutes at 60°C.
Image sections at 80 kV, 40,000× magnification with a transmission electron microscope.
Place one poly-L-lysine coated coverslip into each well of a 12-well plate using forceps.
Add 500–1000 μL of PEG/medium solution to each coverslip.
Centrifuge the plate at 1000 × g for 10 minutes in a tabletop centrifuge using a swinging bucket.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully without disturbing the coverslip.
Fix the MBR coverslips from step 40 or cell and MBR coverslips from step 7 with PHEM-PFA for 15 minutes at 20-25°C.
Wash the fixed coverslips three times for 5 minutes with PBS.
Block the coverslips with PHEM blocking buffer for 45–60 minutes at 37°C or for 2 hours at 20-25°C.
Incubate coverslips with primary antibody diluted in PHEM blocking buffer for 12–18 hours at 4°C.
Wash coverslips three times for 5 minutes with PBS-T.
Incubate the coverslips with secondary antibody diluted in PHEM blocking buffer for 30 minutes at 37°C, 1 hour at 20-25°C, or 12–18 hours at 4°C.
Add fluorophore-conjugated antibodies along with secondary antibodies if necessary.
Wash coverslips four times for 5 minutes with PBS-T.
Mount coverslips onto slides using Fluoro-Gel mounting medium for isolated MBRs or Vectashield mounting medium for cells with MBRs.
Image the MBRs using a 20× objective, or higher as required.
Fix MBR-containing coverslips from HeLa-MKLP1-GFP cells with PHEM-PFA for 15 minutes at 20-25°C.
Wash fixed coverslips three times for 5 minutes with PBS.
Mount the coverslips onto slides using a drop of Fluoro-Gel mounting medium.
Image the MBRs using a 20× objective, or higher as required.
